name: Hotel Review
source:
"Hotel Review" is about a guy who had a little setback with his erotic life and now stays at his old home. Are the things going to be ok with the girls in his life? When they try fairly (or not) to get his attention? -It's your choice-

The game has choices that affect the paths of the story between Love and Corruption!

[From Patreon]
